metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the simulator as a standard Cargo project under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with the entry point at [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It builds with `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` and runs with the required `--input` / `--output` CLI, plus the optional trace, tool-table, parameter-file, block-delete, carousel, and probe arguments.

I also verified the build and a basic linear-motion trace case (`G1 X1 F60` with `--trace-time-step 0.5`), including JSON output and trace-file emission.
